comment: THE one alias-parity fixture: three .flowconfig shapes (old keys only, new keys only, both — in both orders) and the value every renamed key must read as. The CLI (src/cli/state/flowconfig-aliases.test.ts) and the app (app/src/main/flow/worktree-config-aliases.test.ts) both load this file and assert the same expected values, so the two readers cannot drift apart.

cases.name: old keys only
cases.text:
workspace_start: trunk
workspace_cap: 4
workspace_setup: uv sync
workspace_setup_timeout_ms: 60000

cases.name: new keys only
cases.text:
worktree_start: branch:release/2.0
worktree_cap: 12
worktree_setup: npm ci
worktree_setup_timeout_ms: 90000

cases.name: both present, old lines first
cases.text:
workspace_start: trunk
workspace_cap: 4
workspace_setup: uv sync
workspace_setup_timeout_ms: 60000
worktree_start: branch:release/2.0
worktree_cap: 12
worktree_setup: npm ci
worktree_setup_timeout_ms: 90000

cases.name: both present, new lines first
cases.text:

worktree_cap: 12
